M-FLEX-EVENTS.Purpose: Existing native IMGUI event router: transform-aware target selection, pointer and keyboard bubbling, hover path changes and StopPropagation.

Scope.SCP-IN-002: Pointer MouseDown/MouseUp/MouseDrag/ScrollWheel delivery and synthesized hover/move.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Focused keyboard target via FocusManager and target-first ancestor bubbling.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Geometry construction is owned by M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY; coordinate and clip queries are owned by M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE and M-CLIP-SERVICE.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Native control editing or Button.OnClick's action Prop, independently owned by widgets.

Requirements.REQ-001: WidgetHitTester traverses published paint order in reverse, using shared transforms and clips; dispatch bubbles target-first until StopPropagation.
Requirements.REQ-002: Hover changes emit OnMouseEnter and OnMouseLeave along the differing ancestor paths.
Requirements.REQ-003: Keyboard events dispatch only when FocusManager resolves the focused Widget of the current engine.
Requirements.REQ-004: StopPropagation halts bubbling and marks the native event used; the existing native button and FlexEvent systems remain independent.

Outputs.OUT-001: FlexEvent delivered to matching Widget mouse, wheel, hover and keyboard hooks.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Stops native event propagation through Event.Use on handled events.
